::: {.academic-summary}
## About

I am an Assistant Professor at SANKEN, The University of Osaka. My research focuses on **data mining and machine learning for complex, evolving data**.

I develop scalable and interpretable methods for data streams, time series, tensors, and dynamic networks, with applications including anomaly detection, event analysis, and forecasting.

[Research overview](research.qmd) &nbsp;·&nbsp; [About and contact](about.qmd)
:::
:::

::: {.academic-section}
## Research interests

::: {.interest-list}
::: {.interest-item}
### Data streams and time series

Online modeling, change detection, and forecasting for continuously evolving data.
:::

::: {.interest-item}
### Tensor and network mining

Scalable methods for multi-aspect data and dynamic interaction structures.
:::

::: {.interest-item}
### Anomaly detection

Interpretable detection of unusual behavior in complex real-world systems.
:::
:::
